protocol.baseline: Cached target-only generation, not repeated full-prefix decoding.
protocol.order: Rotate by trial+prompt; reverse on odd trials; same four prompts in each variant.
protocol.timing_scope: Complete request including target/draft prefill, Python sampling, verification, rollback and logit materialization. Checkpoint loading and warmup excluded.
protocol.acceptance_denominator: All proposed tokens, including later proposals discarded at an earlier rejection.
